title: Signal Station
author: Luke Steuber
description:
Signal Station keeps selected readings and questions on your Android phone. The optional watch controls request a capture with Up, ask with Select, and open recent history with Down. The phone holds the full records and text replies. Capture needs no provider key.

Use the separate Signal Station Android app for source choices, permissions, local history and your own provider keys. Keep your watch paired in the Pebble app that already manages it. The Android app also works without a watch.

Location, weather, nearby map places, wireless readings, cellular context and supported health data are individually optional. External lookups have their own review before sending. There is no ambient audio or video collection.

This is a development preview. Watch installation remains on hold while an earlier watch-settings reset is investigated. Physical-watch exchange has not been validated.

By Luke Steuber.
